description_en: Queries devices under a specified corpus push task
description_zh: 查询指定语料推送任务下的设备
name: QuerySpeechPushJobDevice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the push task. The Data field returned after a successful call to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html is the push task ID
parameters.help_zh: 推送任务ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/217573.html成功后返回的**Data**字段为推送任务ID
parameters.name: job_code

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页返回数据的最大条数，取值范围：1~50，默认值为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.name: page_id

parameters.help_en:
The push task status. If this parameter is not specified, all types are queried. Valid values:

RUNNING: Running.
SENDING: Sending.
CANCEL: Canceled.
SUCCESS: Succeeded.
TIMEOUT: Timed out
parameters.help_zh:
推送任务状态，不传则查询所有类型。

RUNNING：运行中。
SENDING：正在发送。
CANCEL：取消。
SUCCESS：成功。
TIMEOUT：超时
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You must specify the instance ID. Otherwise, the call fails. You can view your instance ID on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice>
If no ID is available for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

必须传入实例ID，否则调用会失败。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的实例ID。
<notice>
如果公共实例没有ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The devices under the specified corpus push task
Data.description_zh: 返回的指定语料推送任务下的设备

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
PageSize.description_zh: 当前页显示的数据条数

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
Total.description_zh: 查询返回的数据总条数

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: speech solution has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。

true：调用成功。

false：调用失败
